envelope.tactical_move: making the demand to the commission visible and received so the investigation becomes an active external pressure
envelope.state_change_precondition: No sealed demand for an investigation into the burning has yet reached the commission.
envelope.state_change: The sealed letter is handed to the courier and leaves the room bound for the commission.
envelope.forces_choice: forces the PC to choose between waiting for the commission's reply or immediately seeking an ally who can influence the toll road
envelope.branch_a: remain at the posting station to intercept any early response from the commission
envelope.branch_b: ride out at once to meet the merchant who controls the southern toll gate before the summons arrives
envelope.scene_purpose: render the player's committed action of sending the sealed demand on-page and received
envelope.forward_pressure: the commission now holds an active demand that will force responses from those who profited

event_slots.precondition: The PC has prepared the sealed letter and a courier is present.
event_slots.exit_state: the sealed demand has left the room and is en route to the commission
